quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. TERMS AND CONDITIONS : a) Firm has to provide service as per Scope of Work - Annexure-A. b) QUANTITY : THIS TENDER IS MEANT FOR 3000 PROCUREMENT CYCLES (STAGE-I TO STAGE-X) . HOWEVER, THE P AYMENT SHALL BE MADE BASED ON INDIVIDUAL STAGES CARRIED OUT IN A MONTH . c) PAYMENT TERMS: As per scope of work point no. 8 & 9 (v). d) The Bid will also be governed by GeM GTC (General Terms & Conditions). e) Techno commercial terms like specification, deviations, freight charges, insurance, taxes, duties & othe r expenses if any should be specifically indicated in the offer. f) In case, there is any amendment by Govt. in taxes/levies/duties the same will be revived in the line with the AVNL Procurement Manual - 2024 (Stores & Services) and amendment issued from time to time. g) Other terms & condition shall be within overall ambit of AVNL Procurement Manual- 2024 (Stores & Serv ices) and amendment issued from time to time. h) The firm has to submit ink signed and Stamped in each page of Scope of work and attached along with Bid for Technical consideration of their offer. i) VISIT : The interested vendor must visit Machine Tool Prototype Factory (MTPF) on any working day during work hours (10:00 am to 3:00 pm) to understand the scope of work. j) Firms which are having status "SUSPENDED" within last 1 year of generation of Bid in GeM portal, the fi rms will not be considered for technical evaluation. The Seller has to submit self-certification regarding the same along with technical bid. Format is enclosed along with Bid. k) The Seller has to comply and execute the work as per scope of work attached along with the Bid. l) Whether Past Experience of Similar Service is required : "Must have at least one order (either on-going or executed) for any service related to office w orks preferably procurement or consultancy in production or consultancy in R&D or preparatio n of detailed project report in any private or govt. organization. 2. EXPERIENCE & TURNOVER CRITERIA(MSE & STARTUP) : a) The Bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar services over the last 3 years i.e. the cur

rent financial year and the last 3 financial years as per following i.e. one single order of 80% value of the bi d or 2 orders each of 50% value of the bid or 3 orders each of 40% value of the bid or similar services in las t three years to any Central/State Govt. Organization/PSU/Public Listed Company. b) The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during last 3 financial year, ending on 31 March of previous financial year, should be as indicated above in the bid document i.e. Rs.4,67,280 The Do cumentary evidence in the form of certified audited balance sheet(in a separate page/sheet) for relevant p eriod or a certificate from chartered accountant /cost accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder i s less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of co nstitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 3. SERVICE PROVIDER REGION : The firm or start up must have their registered office in MAHARASHTRA. The Firms/Bidders must submit following document in support of above. i) MSME Udyam Registration Certificate having address of Consignee Location i.e. Maharashtra. OR ii) Valid Shop License Certificate having address of Consignee Location i.e. Maharashtra. OR iii) Leave & Licence Agreement Registered Rent Agreement having address of Consignee Location i.e. Mah arashtra issued by Registrar Office. OR iv) GST Certificate . 3.
